column1: # CLASS_AB.tsv -- the fixed tables that STAY FIXED, declared (ceo CEO-1234 (1), 2026-09-24, on the coo's ask; the page
# .github/ARCH-DYNAMIC-STORAGE.md section 2 is the rule, this file is its machine form and the page points here).
# FORMAT: file<TAB>name<TAB>class<TAB>reason -- class A (bounded by the machine or the language definition) or B (scratch for one
# value of fixed width); the reason carries THE MEASUREMENT THAT EARNED THE CLASS, never an opinion.
# READ BY util_dyn_caps_witness.sh census: a declared table leaves the no-guard and drop lines (only a const table leaves them by
# rule, CEO-1234); the ratchet COUNT is unchanged (a class-A table still lands with its BASELINE step). A row naming a table the
# tree no longer declares is a ratchet RED -- a stale declaration is a keep-list nobody notices has stopped applying.
# ⛔ NOT HERE: a table the page lists as class C (convert it), and instrumentation the page says must refuse loudly (guard it).

the machine: the stack-overflow handler's signal alternate stack, 65536 bytes whose one use is ss.ss_sp for sigaltstack (rt_stack_overflow.c:30-32) -- the kernel writes it on SIGSEGV delivery; no program datum enters it

const (by_name_dispatch.c:6873, 0f560a28e) and indexed by a baked builtin id: rtx_misc.s:20-25 takes the id & 0x3FFF into 16-byte rows after refusing a negative id (js) and the 0x4000 flag; every id is a #define in builtin_ids.h and the largest is 189 (BID___pas_swapendian) against BID_TABSZ 1024 -- the bound is held by the id space, not by the 0x3FFF mask, and no assertion ties the two (ceo CEO-1269: A)

const (keywords.c:372, af773a80e): the three words RETURN, FRETURN, NRETURN as 8-byte little-endian constants plus a zero word; the one index is (which >= 0 && which <= 2) ? which : 3 (keywords.c:374) (ceo CEO-1269: A)

an and-masked cache, as g_nv_memo_key (82b4a61a8): RT_CTOR_IC_N 256 is a power of two by _Static_assert (by_name_dispatch.c:5852) and the one index is a Fibonacci hash >> 56 & (RT_CTOR_IC_N - 1), probed at h and h ^ 1 (:5849-5850); a full slot is overwritten (:5851) and a miss (-1) takes the full by-name path rt_call_arr_bl_s, so no program datum is dropped (ceo CEO-1269: A)

an and-masked cache (82b4a61a8): RT_FIELD_IC_N 256 is a power of two by _Static_assert (by_name_dispatch.c:5862) and the one index is a hash of the field-name and type pointers & (RT_FIELD_IC_N - 1) (:5866); a hit is confirmed by strcmp against the type's own field name (:5867) and a miss scans idb->fields (:5868) (ceo CEO-1269: A)

an and-masked cache (82b4a61a8): RT_TWEAK_IC_N 64 is a power of two by _Static_assert (by_name_dispatch.c:1094) and the one index is (cname >> 3) & (RT_TWEAK_IC_N - 1) (:1100); a full slot is overwritten (:1105) and a miss walks the full dat_mro chain (:1102) (ceo CEO-1269: A)

three compile-time scratch buffers of one fixed-width value each, all named b: b[8][40] at :36 is gva_cell_addr's ring of "[" RTCC_GVA_REG " + %d]" (r9, an int: at most 19 bytes of 40; one slot is live per x86() call), and b[24] at :38 (1a350a380) and :59 each hold strtab_label's ".S%d" of an int index (emit.cpp:404: at most 14 bytes of 24) (ceo CEO-1269: B)

bounded by the language definition: the icn_opproc_table entry for each Icon operator a procedure value can name (proc(s, i), args()), const, initialized at its declaration and never written; the longest symbol is ~=== (4 characters + NUL = 5 of 6). Its own storage is the point: a procedure value names its entry by address, so proc("*",1) and proc("*",2) stay distinct values, which pointers to two merged "*" literals could not (hq_icon 2026-09-26)

STAGE2_PL_PRED_TABLE_SIZE is the WIDTH of a chained hash (256 chain heads), not the capacity of a list: every predicate goes into a chain and no count of predicates can fill it (prolog-600-predicates witness green at 600 = 2.3 per chain); growing it would rehash, which reorders the two bucket-order walks that fix the order predicates are lowered and their bb_idx (lower_prolog.c) -- a Prolog-lane change, not a cap cure; declared A by the cfo 2026-09-27 under CEO-1332

an and-masked cache (RT_DCAP_NVCACHE_N 16, a power of two; the one index is a hash of the name pointer & (RT_DCAP_NVCACHE_N - 1) at pattern_match.c:781 and :860, a miss re-looks the name up): eviction by construction, never a population a program fills
the cell column of the same and-masked cache as g_dcap_nv_key (:782, :784)
the generation column of the same and-masked cache as g_dcap_nv_key (:782, :784)

instrumentation (the zeta state-machine census under SCRIP_ZSM_CENSUS / SCRIP_ZSM_LEAK_REPORT), an and-masked map of node & (ZSM_N - 1) at runtime_init.c:79 and :101 -- a collision is a census imprecision, never a program limit; the page lists instrumentation as class A by declaration, refusing loudly where it drops (g_zsm_seen_nodes aborts at ZSM_N)
an and-masked cache: index ((uintptr_t)nm >> 4) & DCR_CELL_CACHE_MASK at rt.c:1359 (rt_cell_for); a full slot is overwritten and a miss recomputes through NV_PTR_fn
the slot column of an and-masked cache: index ((uintptr_t)name >> 4) & DCR_CELL_CACHE_MASK at rt.c:1909 (rt_proc_index_of) and rt.c:1926; a miss recomputes through rt_proc_hash_lookup
the key column of the same and-masked cache as g_proc_idx_slot (rt.c:1909 and rt.c:1926)
the five callee-saved registers of the SysV x86-64 ABI a generator record keeps (rbx, r12, r13, r14, r15 -- rt.c:1284 saves exactly these five); the machine's register file, not a population

an address-space reservation, not a fill limit: 1 GB mapped MAP_NORESERVE at the pinned RT_GVA_VA the emitter bakes into every global-variable cell address, committed only as cells are touched; rt_gva_island extends the mapping contiguously past it on demand, doubling (rt.c:528) -- the only refusal is the address space beyond it being taken
the register-cache block of the RTCC ABI: one slot per RTCC_SLOT_* constant, the offsets static_asserted in x86_asm.h; its size is the ABI's register file, not a population
a co-expression's copy of the RTCC register-cache block (rtccb, rtcc_init.c): the same fixed ABI slot set, saved and restored whole at every switch
indexed by the heap block kind masked & 511 at gc_heap.c:325; the kinds are the compile-time HB_* set of gc_heap.h, every one below 512 (the allocation histogram under SCRIP_ALLOC_HIST)

a sample table written from the SIGPROF handler (bbprof_pc_note, bbprof.c:53), where no allocator may run: open-addressed, masked & (BBPROF_PC_CAP - 1); a sample of a new C site past a full table only loses rank below the report's top 15
a character-class bitmap over the byte alphabet: 256 bits in 32 bytes, indexed c >> 3 for an unsigned char c (re.c cc_set, cc_test)

an and-masked cache of replace() translation maps (bn_replace, by_name_dispatch.c:7120): the one index is ((unsigned char)fv[0] * 31u + fl) & 3u into its 4 rows (:7131); a full slot is overwritten on a miss (:7133-7134), and SCRIP_REPLMAP_OFF or a from-string of 63 bytes or more builds the map in the local mloc on every call instead (:7130, :7135), so no replace() argument is refused or truncated by it

the from-string key of a g_rm cache row (bn_replace, by_name_dispatch.c:7120): written only under the admission test fl < 63 (:7131, :7134); a longer from-string is never stored and its map is rebuilt in the local mloc on every call (:7135); compared by memcmp, never grown

the to-string key of a g_rm cache row (bn_replace, by_name_dispatch.c:7120): replace() refuses tl != fl before the cache is read (error 171), and the row is written only under fl < 63 (:7131, :7134); a longer pair is never stored and is mapped through the local mloc (:7135)

the 256-byte translation table of a g_rm cache row (bn_replace, by_name_dispatch.c:7120): every read and write is indexed by an unsigned char (:7133, :7135, rt_translate_bytes :7114), bounded by the byte range by construction

the builtin-name key of a dispatch cache row (dtax_ent_t, by_name_dispatch.c:7194): written only for a name under 14 bytes -- the id path admits _fnlen < 14 and the hash path counts _dxl < 14 and leaves no row (_dx stays 0) for a longer name (:7675), which then resolves through the full dispatch on every call; confirmed by len and memcmp (:7677)

an and-masked cache (by_name_dispatch.c:7195): the one index is _dxh & 255u, a multiplicative hash of the builtin name (:7675); a hit is confirmed by len and memcmp against the stored name and the rt_dtax_gen generation (:7677), a full slot is overwritten, and a miss resolves through the full dispatch

indexed by a builtin id (by_name_dispatch.c:7196): the one index is _bid under the test _bid > 0 && _bid <= 1024 (:7675); every id is a #define in builtin_ids.h, the largest is BID_LAST 189, and _Static_assert(BID_LAST < BID_TABSZ) with BID_TABSZ 1024 keeps the id space inside the table (builtin_ids.h:199-201); an id outside it would take the name-hash path

an instrumentation table behind SCRIP_BID_PROF=1 (by_name_dispatch.c:7268-7271), one counter per builtin id: both increments are guarded _fb < 1024 and _bid < 1024 (:7648, :7667) and every id is at most BID_LAST 189 < BID_TABSZ 1024 by _Static_assert (builtin_ids.h:199-201), so the id space is a compile-time count

the from-string key of a map() translation cache row (map_cache_t, by_name_dispatch.c:8307): written only under the admission test fl <= 256 && tl <= 256 (:8311, :8320); a longer map() call takes the uncached per-character path on every call (:8323-8329) and is never truncated

the to-string key of a map() translation cache row (map_cache_t, by_name_dispatch.c:8307): written only under the admission test fl <= 256 && tl <= 256 (:8311, :8320); a longer map() call takes the uncached per-character path on every call (:8323-8329) and is never truncated

the 256-entry translation table of a map() cache row (map_cache_t, by_name_dispatch.c:8307): every read and write is indexed by an unsigned char or a loop to 256 (:8318-8319, :8322), bounded by the byte range by construction

a round-robin cache of 8 map() translation tables by design (by_name_dispatch.c:8308): the insert index is map_cache_next = (map_cache_next + 1) & 7 (:8317), a lookup scans the 8 rows (:8312-8315), a full slot is overwritten, and a miss rebuilds the row while a from/to string over 256 bytes takes the uncached path (:8311, :8323)

a most-recent ring by design, not a population (Icon trace of suspended generator handles, instrumentation behind TRACE): at 256 the OLDEST handle is shifted out and the newest appended (core.c:563-564), and the one lookup walks newest first (core.c:568); a handle shifted out only loses the trace's failed-after-return suppression for that oldest generator, never a program datum

bounded by the language definition: &RTNTYPE holds one of the three SNOBOL4 words RETURN, FRETURN, NRETURN; every write is one of them -- keywords.c:379 stores one 8-byte little-endian word from its const words table, rtx_misc.s:70 stores the same three words, driver_call.c:125/128/131 strncpy the literals -- 7 bytes + NUL of 16
bounded by the language definition: &UCASE, the 26 upper-case letters + NUL, initialized at its declaration (core.c:1133) and never written (core.h:355 is the one extern)
bounded by the language definition: &LCASE, the 26 lower-case letters + NUL, initialized at its declaration (core.c:1134) and never written (core.h:356 is the one extern)
bounded by the language definition: the 10 decimal digits + NUL, initialized at its declaration (core.c:1135) and never written (core.h:358 is the one extern)
bounded by the machine: &ALPHABET, the 256 byte values + NUL, filled once by the i < 256 loop at core.c:2559-2560 and never written after
const and bounded by the language definition: the SNOBOL4 message text of error codes 1..39, initialized at its declaration (core.c:2845) and read only at core.c:2908 under code >= 1 && code <= 39
bounded by the machine: a 256-bit membership set of one cset, one bit per byte value, indexed only by an unsigned char c >> 3 (0..31) at keywords.c:121

an and-masked cache: the one index is ((uintptr_t)ptr >> 4) & 63u (keywords.c:224); a full slot is overwritten and a miss takes the full kw_cset_find_ptr lookup, and kw_cset_gc_weak clears it whole (keywords.c:213), so no program datum is dropped
the length column of the same and-masked cache as g_kw_cset_regc_ptr (keywords.c:224 index and write)

bounded by the language definition: one int64 cell per SNOBOL4 keyword that has no C home of its own -- &CASE, &ERRTYPE, &ABEND, &INPUT, &OUTPUT, &PROFILE, &COMPARE and the user-declared-constants switch -- each addressed by a constant index in the const g_kwb table (keywords.c:265-293) and aliased as rt_kwb_own for emitted code; no index is computed from program data

bounded by the machine: &host, filled once by gethostname(2), which on Linux returns at most HOST_NAME_MAX = 64 bytes (the kernel's utsname nodename field is 65), into 255 of 256 bytes (keywords.c:560)

instrumentation, a most-recent ring by design: the zeta state-machine trace (SCRIP_ZSM, SCRIP_ZSM_RING) keeps the last ZSM_TRACE 2048 port events, written at g_zsm_tr_n % ZSM_TRACE (runtime_init.c:102-104) and dumped oldest-first from that modulus (:66-70); an overwritten entry is an older event by construction, never a program datum

bounded by a const name table: one flag per entry of RK_LISTLIKE_METHNAMES (lower_raku.c:67, the ten names keys values kv sort reverse grep map split words comb plus a NULL end), read only at an index rk_listlike_idx returns (:69, an index into that table or -1, checked li >= 0 at :129) and written only by the loop over the same table (:895); no program datum chooses the index

indexed by a Bison token kind, a fixed set the grammar defines: the enum in src/parsers/snocone/snocone_parse.tab.h has 82 kinds, the largest T_WHILE = 339 (< 512); written only at T_* constants (snocone_lex.c:36-42) and read only by sc_kind_is_value behind kind >= 0 && kind < 512 (:54); a token kind is never program data

indexed by a Bison token kind, as sc_value_table: written only at the T_* constants T_IDENT T_CALL T_INT T_REAL T_STR T_KEYWORD (snocone_lex.c:43-48), all <= 339 of the 82-kind enum in snocone_parse.tab.h; no reader exists (sc_kind_has_payload is declared in snocone_lex.h and defined nowhere)

one label per SNOBOL4 floater kind (1 RETURN, 2 FRETURN, 3 NRETURN): emit_floater_kind (emit.cpp:107) returns only 0..3, the one index is emit_floater_label's k, refused outside 1..3 (emit.cpp:109), and the resets write only [1..3] (emit.cpp:82, :3176); slot 0 is never written -- bounded by the kind set, no program datum indexes it

IR_ref_t.sz is one port tag: a Greek letter in UTF-8 (2 bytes), an optional '!' and the NUL. Every write is a literal of at most 4 bytes -- 'α' 'β' 'φ' 'σ' (3 with the NUL) and 'α!' (4) in lower_common.c:201-207 and the lowerers; pl_mark_into copies strlen+1 of its only argument 'β' (lower_prolog.c:472, :596); branch_chain.c:31/:49 copies 4 bytes from another sz; lower_snobol4.c:1593 clears byte 0 -- no program datum reaches it

the compile-time arena's own shape: one free list per power-of-two size class, 16 bytes to 8 MB (CT_BINS 20, CT_MIN_CLASS 16). Every index is a class from ct_class_of (ct_arena.c:33-38), which returns 0..CT_BINS-1 or -1; ct_alloc sends -1 to the page-mapped path (ct_arena.c:47-48) and ct_drop returns on it (:101-102) before touching the bins (:57, :108-109) -- fixed by construction, never a population a program fills

instrumentation behind SCRIP_ZOP_AUDIT: a histogram with one bin per value of a four-bit field, indexed only as zop_hist[(m >> 1) & 15] (frame_layout.c:1224) and read by k < 16 against the sixteen names of zop_audit_report (:1232) -- and-masked by construction, no program datum can index past it

the machine: one role annotation per SysV x86-64 integer argument register (rdi rsi rdx rcx r8 r9). The table x86_argroles[123] is const and generated (x86_arg_roles.cpp:249), and its one read is rr->role[slot] (x86_asm.h:1389) with slot from x86_argreg_slot (x86_asm.h:1345), which maps only those six registers' names to 0..5 and refuses (-1) anything else

sixteen operand-text rings, all named b, each formatting one fixed-width value: L :569 ('L%d' of an internal label number that x86_internal_id holds to [0, 250) at :565), x86_zop/x86_ztos/x86_zref :861/:873/:882 ('qword ptr [rsp# + %d]', 31 bytes with the NUL, of 48), PAIR :900 ('P%d', 12 of 16), ROQ/RDQ/ABSQ/GVARQ :926-929 and RDD :937 (an int or unsigned long, or a base register of at most 4 bytes that x86_parse re-parses and encodes only when x86_is_reg accepts it: at most 33 of 40), ZOPAN/ZOPN :933/:935 (an IR op-kind name from kind_names, the longest IR_MATCH_ASSIGN_SAVE lowercasing to 17 bytes, of 48), LIDX :983 ('[r13+rcx+%ld]', 31 of 32), RSP :1190 and x86_rsp_release_to :1898 (30 of 40), F64 :1191 ('f64:%llu', 25 of 32). The ring depth is how many operands one x86() call holds live; no program datum reaches any of them

opnd.base holds one base-register name parsed out of an operand text the templates format ('qword ptr [%s + %d]', '[%s+%s]', '[%s]'): a register name is at most 4 bytes (r15d, xmm7) and x86_is_reg (x86_asm.h:1254) accepts nothing longer; every REGDISP/MEMBI/MEMIND encoding copies or keeps it only after x86_is_reg accepts it (:1287, :1293, :1301, :1323, :1328), so a text truncated to 7 bytes is refused, never taken as a register
two operand-text rings (trd :29, trq :30), each 'dword/qword ptr [rsp + %d]' of one int: at most 29 bytes of 40; eight slots, one x86() call's live operands
HKQ's operand-text ring (bb_match_end.cpp:23): 'qword ptr [rsp# + %d]' of 16 + 8k, one int, at most 30 bytes of 40
strtab_label's '.S%d' of an int string-table index (emit.cpp:434), at most 13 bytes of 24 (bb_match_defer.cpp:38-39), as bb_match_capture.cpp's b
a ring of one data label each, 'g_sno_defer_cells+%d' of ci * 8 with ci < 2048 (bb_match_defer.cpp:44-45): at most 24 bytes of 48
a ring of one data label each, 'g_sno_defer_cells+%d' of (2048 + 2 * msite) * 8 with msite < 1024 (bb_match_defer.cpp:48-49): at most 24 bytes of 48

an address-space reservation, not a fill limit: the trail first maps 1 MB MAP_NORESERVE at the base of a free 1 TB-aligned block (rt_pl_trail.c rt_pl_tr_init; the base is r12 & -2^40, the mask rtx_plunify.s and x86_pl_tr_top_sync spell), committed only as entries are touched; rt_pl_tr_grow extends the mapping in place, doubling, when a push reaches the mapped end word at [base+16] -- the only refusal is the next pages of the block being unmappable (RLIMIT_AS, or the address space taken) or the whole 1 TB block full
